channel.title: Ascentery blog
channel.description: Notes on Ascentery's text adventures and the talking avatar.

item.title: A Verb Is a Promise You Make to Yourself
item.description: The parser doesn't test your imagination. It tests whether you can bear to be told no by a machine you already know will say yes eventually.

item.title: The Fae Grounds Paints a Garden You Never Noticed
item.description: Inside The Fae Grounds: how its painted garden, silver-green palette and quiet fae folklore turn an ordinary path into somewhere else.

item.title: A Failed Command Is the Game Talking Back
item.description: The parser's rejections are not obstacles between you and the story. They are the story, and the most honest part of the form.

item.title: A Locked Door Is a Question, Not a Wall
item.description: Adventure games don't block you with locked doors. They hand you a sentence you haven't finished yet.

item.title: A Walkthrough for The Last Delivery
item.description: A spoiler-warned, plain-English route through Ascentery's claymation morning: the bakery, the post office, the basement, and the town hall door.

item.title: The Mouse Hunt: Three Cheeses and a Sleeping Cat
item.description: A small mouse, a sleeping cat and three hidden cheeses. A warm introduction to The Mouse Hunt, a text adventure you play in the browser.
